name: gizza-ai/video-reverse
summary: Reverse a video clip, with audio options

tool.description: Reverse a video clip locally with ffmpeg. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). mode controls straight reverse or boomerang output (reverse|forward-reverse|reverse-forward). audio controls the soundtrack (reverse|keep|mute). quality controls H.264 CRF (high|balanced|small). Output is MP4. Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

audio.description: How to handle sound: reverse matches the backwards picture, keep leaves a forward-playing copy of the original sound, and mute removes the audio track.

mode.description: Playback shape for the output video. reverse plays the clip backwards. forward-reverse makes a boomerang that plays forward then backward. reverse-forward starts with the reversed half, then returns forward.

quality.description: H.264 output quality/size preset. high uses CRF 18, balanced uses CRF 23, and small uses CRF 28. Reversing always re-encodes because ffmpeg must reorder frames.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
